cirrus.config.title: Cirrus Settings
cirrus.config.category.clouds.descriptio: Shape, position, motion, and visibility for all cloud layers.
cirrus.config.category.skyColors.descrip: Colors, gradients, and smooth transitions for every part of the Overworld day.
cirrus.config.category.sky.description: Stars and atmospheric effects for the Overworld and the End.
Smooths abrupt sky changes when commands, sleeping, or servers change the world time. Disable to show time changes immediately.
cirrus.config.sky.timeTransitionSpeed.de: Controls how quickly smooth time transitions finish. Higher values make the sky catch up faster.
cirrus.config.sky.customStarsEnabled.des: Replaces vanilla stars with a configurable shader-rendered field while preserving their crisp pixel shape.
cirrus.config.sky.starDensity.descriptio: Sets the number of stars across the complete celestial sphere. Roughly half are above the horizon at once.
cirrus.config.sky.starMinimumOpacity.des: Sets the opacity of the dimmest stars. Values are safely reordered if this exceeds the maximum.
cirrus.config.sky.starMaximumOpacity.des: Sets the opacity of the brightest stars.
cirrus.config.sky.starMinimumSize.descri: Sets the size multiplier for the smallest stars. Values are safely reordered if this exceeds the maximum.
cirrus.config.sky.starMaximumSize.descri: Sets the size multiplier for the largest stars.
cirrus.config.sky.starTwinkleStrength.de: Controls how much each star gently varies in brightness.
cirrus.config.sky.starTwinkleSpeed.descr: Controls how quickly stars twinkle. Zero freezes their current brightness.
cirrus.config.sky.starColorVariation.des: Adds subtle warm and cool differences between stars. Zero keeps every star neutral white.
cirrus.config.sky.shootingStarsEnabled.d: Shows occasional shader-animated shooting stars in the night sky.
cirrus.config.sky.shootingStarPixelatedT: Breaks each trail into crisp light fragments while keeping the shooting star's bright head smooth.
Sets the number of shooting-star events per real-world minute. Zero disables events.
cirrus.config.sky.shootingStarOpacity.de: Controls the maximum visibility of shooting-star heads and trails.
cirrus.config.sky.shootingStarMinimumSiz: Sets the width of the smallest shooting stars. Values are safely reordered if this exceeds the maximum.
cirrus.config.sky.shootingStarMaximumSiz: Sets the width of the largest shooting stars.
cirrus.config.sky.shootingStarMinimumSpe: Sets the speed of the slowest shooting stars. Values are safely reordered if this exceeds the maximum.
cirrus.config.sky.shootingStarMaximumSpe: Sets the speed of the fastest shooting stars.
cirrus.config.sky.shootingStarSpeedVaria: Controls how strongly individual shooting stars accelerate or decelerate as they burn. Minimum and maximum speed still set the overall range.
cirrus.config.sky.shootingStarTrailLengt: Controls how far the glowing trail extends behind each shooting star.
cirrus.config.sky.shootingStarBloom.desc: Controls the strength and reach of the soft colored glow around each bright core and trail.
cirrus.config.sky.shootingStarColorVaria: Controls the range of warm amber and cool blue tones. Zero keeps shooting stars neutral.
cirrus.config.sky.skyGradientsEnabled.de: Adds configurable horizon-to-upper-sky colors that transition smoothly through morning, day, evening, and night.
cirrus.config.sky.skyGradientOpacity.des: Controls how strongly every custom gradient blends over Minecraft's original sky.
cirrus.config.sky.skyGradientTransitionT: Sets how long neighboring time-of-day palettes cross-fade. Zero switches palettes immediately.
cirrus.config.sky.skyGradientHeight.desc: Controls how high the horizon color reaches before blending fully into the upper sky color.
cirrus.config.sky.morningHorizonColor.de: Sets the warm color along the morning horizon.
cirrus.config.sky.morningZenithColor.des: Sets the color directly overhead during the morning.
cirrus.config.sky.morningGradientStrengt: Controls the visibility of the morning palette independently.
cirrus.config.sky.dayHorizonColor.descri: Sets the color along the daytime horizon.
cirrus.config.sky.dayZenithColor.descrip: Sets the color directly overhead during the day.
cirrus.config.sky.dayGradientStrength.de: Controls the visibility of the daytime palette independently.
cirrus.config.sky.eveningHorizonColor.de: Sets the warm color along the evening horizon.
cirrus.config.sky.eveningZenithColor.des: Sets the color directly overhead during the evening.
cirrus.config.sky.eveningGradientStrengt: Controls the visibility of the evening palette independently.
cirrus.config.sky.nightHorizonColor.desc: Sets the low-sky color at night.
cirrus.config.sky.nightZenithColor.descr: Sets the deep color directly overhead at night.
Controls the visibility of the night palette independently from the Milky Way.
cirrus.config.sky.milkyWayEnabled.descri: Shows a shader-driven galactic band behind clouds and northern lights.
cirrus.config.sky.milkyWayPixelationEnab: Samples the Milky Way through a sky-fixed pixel grid. Disable for smooth galactic clouds.
cirrus.config.sky.milkyWayPixelationReso: Controls the Milky Way pixel size. Lower values make each pixel larger; higher values create a finer grid.
cirrus.config.sky.milkyWayOpacity.descri: Controls the brightness and visibility of the galactic haze, dust lanes, and stellar core.
cirrus.config.sky.auroraEnabled.descript: Shows animated northern lights at night using the visibility and animation settings below.
cirrus.config.sky.auroraPixelationEnable: Samples northern lights through the same sky-fixed pixel grid as the Milky Way.
cirrus.config.sky.auroraPixelationResolu: Controls the northern-light pixel size. Lower values make each pixel larger; higher values create a finer grid.
cirrus.config.sky.auroraColdBiomesOnly.d: Restricts northern lights to freezing biomes. Disable this to show them in every biome.
cirrus.config.sky.auroraOpacity.descript: Controls the maximum brightness and visibility of the northern lights.
cirrus.config.sky.auroraAnimationSpeed.d: Controls how quickly the northern lights drift and reshape. Zero freezes the animation.
cirrus.config.sky.auroraMovement.descrip: Controls how far the ribbons wave, drift, breathe, and change their reach.
cirrus.config.sky.auroraRibbonWidth.desc: Controls the width of all northern-light ribbons.
cirrus.config.sky.auroraHeight.descripti: Moves the complete northern-lights display higher or lower in the sky.
cirrus.config.sky.auroraNightlyVariation: Controls how different the ribbon count, spacing, shape, coverage, and colors can be each night.
cirrus.config.sky.endSkyEnabled.descript: Replaces the plain End sky with moving clouds, lightning, and spreading darkness.
cirrus.config.sky.endSkyPixelationEnable: Gives the End sky a pixelated look that fits Minecraft.
cirrus.config.sky.endSkyPixelationResolu: Controls the End sky pixel size. Lower values make each pixel larger; higher values create a finer grid.
cirrus.config.sky.endSkyIntensity.descri: Changes how bright and colorful the End sky is.
cirrus.config.sky.endSkyAnimationSpeed.d: Changes how fast the cloud layers move. Set it to 0 to stop them.
cirrus.config.sky.endSkyMorphSpeed.descr: Changes how quickly the clouds and dark patches change shape. Set it to 0 to stop them.
cirrus.config.sky.endSkyVoidCoverage.des: Changes how much of the sky is covered by black patches.
cirrus.config.sky.endSkyVoidDarkness.des: Changes how dark the black patches are.
cirrus.config.sky.endSkyLightningFrequen: Changes how often lightning appears. Set it to 0 to turn it off.
cirrus.config.sky.endSkyLightningIntensi: Changes how bright the lightning and the clouds around it become.
cirrus.config.sky.endSkySurgeFrequency.d: Changes how often darkness spreads across the sky. Set it to 0 to turn it off.
cirrus.config.sky.endSkySurgeStrength.de: Changes how dark the sky becomes when the darkness spreads.
cirrus.config.clouds.enabled.description: Replaces vanilla clouds with Cirrus clouds. The vanilla Clouds: Off setting still hides clouds.
cirrus.config.clouds.renderDistanceChunk: Cloud distance in chunks, independent of terrain render distance.
cirrus.config.clouds.customLightningEnab: Replaces vanilla bolts with narrow, animated channels that fork into layered electric branches.
cirrus.config.clouds.lightningBoltIntens: Controls the brightness of Cirrus lightning cores and their blue-violet glow.
cirrus.config.clouds.hideLightningCloudF: Disables lightning illumination on Cirrus clouds without changing Minecraft's sky flash. Minecraft's Hide Lightning Flashes option can still suppress both.
cirrus.config.clouds.lightningCloudFlash: Controls how strongly nearby clouds brighten during a lightning strike.
cirrus.config.clouds.lowerLayerStyle.des: Fast draws a flat cloud plane for better performance. Fancy gives the layer four-block thickness with shaded sides.
cirrus.config.clouds.lowerLayerHeightOff: Moves the lower layer relative to the dimension's normal cloud height.
cirrus.config.clouds.lowerLayerSpeed.des: Controls lower-layer wind speed. Zero keeps the pattern stationary.
cirrus.config.clouds.lowerLayerOpacity.d: Controls lower-layer transparency independently from the other layers.
cirrus.config.clouds.upperLayerEnabled.d: Enables the independently sampled upper cloud layer.
cirrus.config.clouds.upperLayerStyle.des: Fast draws a flat cloud plane for better performance. Fancy gives the layer four-block thickness with shaded sides.
cirrus.config.clouds.upperLayerHeightOff: Sets the upper layer's height above the lower cloud layer.
cirrus.config.clouds.upperLayerSpeed.des: Controls upper-layer wind speed independently; it defaults slower than the lower layer.
cirrus.config.clouds.upperLayerOpacity.d: Controls upper-layer transparency independently from the other layers.
cirrus.config.clouds.topLayerEnabled.des: Enables a third, independently sampled cloud layer above the upper layer.
cirrus.config.clouds.topLayerStyle.descr: Fast draws a flat cloud plane for better performance. Fancy gives the layer four-block thickness with shaded sides.
cirrus.config.clouds.topLayerHeightOffse: Sets the top layer's height above the upper cloud layer.
cirrus.config.clouds.topLayerSpeed.descr: Controls top-layer wind speed independently; it defaults slower than the upper layer.
cirrus.config.clouds.topLayerOpacity.des: Controls top-layer transparency independently; it defaults more transparent than the other layers.
